newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end down as 2 top blue chips slip.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end down as 2 top blue chips slip.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed down in trading dominated by profit-taking in two prime blue chips.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index ended down 0.15 percent to 18,017.76 on above average volume of 3.5 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index fell 0.42 percent to 1,181.71 on volume of about 2.6 billion pesos.
Giant brewer Bavaria led the fall, dropping 0.38 percent to 7,800 pesos on volume of 1 billion pesos in Bogota, and receding 0.63 percent to 7,800 on volume of 972 million in Medellin.
"Nothing spectacular happened to Bavaria. Mid-term investors who've held the stock since as far back as January got tired of waiting and started to sell," a Medellin broker said.
Banco de Colombia, the country's second largest bank in assets, dropped 0.98 percent to 401 on both markets on volumes of 351 million pesos in Bogota and 12 million pesos in Medellin.
"The same thing could happen to Banco de Colombia as happened to other stocks that stayed down after giant drops, especially since the bank has been seen as speculative stock," the broker said.
